title: Tyropita
subtitle: Greek filo pastry filled with salty feta and egg
excerpt: Crisp, shatteringly thin filo wrapped around a simple mix of feta and egg. This is Greek cheese pie at its most direct. Serve it warm from the oven and eat it the same day.
sourceNotes: Greek home-baking tradition. Feta and egg filling is the standard form found across mainland Greece and the islands.

recipe.freezeNotes: Freeze unbaked, layered between sheets of baking paper. Bake straight from frozen at 190C, adding 10 minutes to the cooking time.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Assemble the pie up to 4 hours ahead and keep it covered in the fridge. Bake just before serving.

content.text: Tyropita is a Greek cheese pie built from filo sheets and a salty feta filling. Keep the filling simple and handle the filo fast so it does not dry out. The top should be deeply golden and crackle when you cut it.
Heat the oven to 190C. Brush a 30 x 20 cm baking tray with melted butter.
Mix the crumbled feta, beaten eggs, and milk together in a large bowl. Season with black pepper. Feta is already salty, so do not add salt.
Lay one sheet of filo in the tray and brush it with melted butter. Repeat with five more sheets, brushing each one.
Spread the feta filling evenly over the layered filo. Do not press it down.
Layer the remaining six sheets on top, brushing each with melted butter. Tuck in any overhanging edges.
Score the top layers into portions with a sharp knife. This makes it easier to cut cleanly after baking.
Bake for 35 minutes until the top is deep gold all over. Rest for 10 minutes before cutting along the scored lines.

items.symptom: The filo tears when I handle it.
items.fix: Keep unused sheets under a damp tea towel. Work one sheet at a time.

items.symptom: The base is soft and pale.
items.cause: The tray was not preheated or the base sheets were not buttered well.
items.fix: Place the tray on a preheated baking sheet on the bottom shelf for a crisper base.

items.symptom: The filling is watery after baking.
items.cause: The feta had too much moisture.
items.fix: Drain and pat the feta dry before mixing. Block feta holds less water than pre-crumbled.
